ui.health.commit.2: ✓ It is never shared with third parties, advertisers or insurance companies
ui.health.commit.3: ✓ Raw data values are not stored on OUT servers; they are shown straight from your device

ui.health.commit.5: ✓ Everything is deleted when you delete your account
ui.health.commit.6: ✓ You can revoke access at any time in your phone settings
